jobs.title: Town Planning | Expression of Interest
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Join Our Town Planning Talent Network

Are you an experienced Town Planner
looking for your next opportunity with an established and growing team? Do you want to work on a diverse range of exciting projects, shape the future of places and communities, and have access to fantastic career development opportunities? If so, Stantec could be for you.

We're continuing to grow our Town Planning teams
across the UK
and are keen to connect with talented planning professionals at a range of levels, from Planner and Senior Planner through to Associate, Associate Director and Director level.

Our Planning teams are based across Bristol, Taunton, Cardiff, Birmingham, Reading, Kings Hill, London, Cambridge, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle, Edinburgh and Glasgow
, offering opportunities to work on projects at a local, regional and national scale.

Explore more about our Town Planning projects and expertise here .

Our Teams Work Across a Diverse Portfolio, Including

Residential and mixed-use development.
Strategic planning and new settlements.
Commercial and employment-led development.
Energy and infrastructure projects.
Urban regeneration and development.
Planning strategy, applications and appeals.
Explore more about our Town Planning projects and expertise here.

About You

We're looking for passionate and commercially aware Town Planners who want to make a positive impact through their work and develop their careers within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

You'll Have Experience In Some Of The Following Areas

Chartered MRTPI status or working towards chartership.
Proven planning experience within a consultancy, private sector or public sector environment.
Preparing, submitting and negotiating planning applications across a variety of scales and project types.
Experience across residential, mixed-use, strategic, commercial and/or energy projects.
Coordinating internal and external project teams and ensuring high-quality project delivery.
Building and maintaining strong client relationships and providing commercially focused planning advice.
For more senior roles, experience of planning appeals and appearing at informal hearings is advantageous.
Local knowledge and experience of working within the region you're interested in joining is beneficial, although relocators are very welcome to apply.
A full UK driving licence and access to a car would be advantageous for some roles.
If your experience doesn't tick every box, we still encourage you to apply we hire people, not checklists.

Interested in Being Part of Our Journey?

Great talent doesn't always wait for the perfect vacancy, and neither do we. We're always looking to connect with talented planning professionals and build our pipeline for future opportunities.

Whether you're looking for your next role now or simply want to explore what a future with Stantec could look like, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Us

We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed.
We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025. Named ‘Best Place to Work’ and ‘International Consulting Firm of the Year’ at the NCE Awards 2024.
We do what is right: Industry leading training and development as well as paid for professional subscriptions. A p rofessional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered with ICE.
We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )
Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the UK & Ireland - we want you to be part of it!
Great Benefits: Competitive salary, bonus schemes, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard as well as discounted gym membership and lots more.
Flexible working: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with our hybrid approach to flexible working.

#TownPlanning

About Stantec

The Stantec community unites more than 34,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents. We have been working with our clients and communities in the UK for over 150 years. We plan, design, deliver and manage the development and infrastructure needed to support the creation of sustainable, healthy and prosperous communities.

Our teams provide effective and relevant solutions, translating our clients’ vision into valued consents, deliverable plans for projects and programmes, and efficient designs for delivery, based on technical excellence and deep market insights. We deal with today’s challenges, but also keep a fairer, better tomorrow in sight, looking at how we deliver clean growth, support radical changes in our economy and meet the needs of future communities.

Stantec provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for future and current employment and prohibit discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. We prohibit discrimination in decisions concerning recruitment, hiring, referral, promotion, compensation, fringe benefits, job training, terminations or any other condition of employment. Stantec is in compliance with laws and regulations and ensures equitable opportunities in all aspects of employment.

Building an inspired, inclusive work environment that attracts, supports, and develops world-class talent is a crucial key to our success. If you are excited by this role but worry that your experience doesn’t exactly align, we encourage you to apply.

At Stantec we want you to perform your best at every stage of the recruitment process and are committed to ensuring it is accessible to all. If you need any support or require adjustments to be made then please contact careers.UK& [email protected] we will talk to you about how we can support you.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Solutions Consultant
, you will be the principal technical liaison between our product, sales, and customer success teams. You will provide tailored solutions for clients in the commercial real estate sector, specifically focusing on the complex VTS Activate product landscape (including Activate, Activate Workplace, Activate Multifamily, CBRE Host, and CBRE Host Building)
. Your unique combination of property management experience and deep technical proficiency will help ensure that our clients maximize the value of our software.

Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome?

Act as the definitive subject matter expert (SME) and technical leader for the VTS Activate suite's integration landscape and partnerships, both internally and externally (e.g., Braxos, Kastle, CCure, AMAG, etc.).
Design and deliver advanced, in-depth technical demonstrations for prospects and clients, specifically showcasing how the VTS Activate product suite solves specific challenges.
Provide advanced technical support during the sales process, addressing complex questions and concerns about system integrations and core functionalities, serving as the technical closer for Activate deals.
Provide support during the sales process for qualifying opportunities with hardware requirement and implementation. Provide handover details to cross-functional stakeholders to ensure smooth implementations.
Own the solution reporting process for VTS Activate deals, including documenting deal journals and synthesizing won/loss reasons. This reporting provides critical intelligence for the Product team (feature gaps), the Sales team (competitive analysis), and the Executive team (market/product trends).
Lead knowledge transfer and cross-functional upskilling initiatives for the Sales, Customer Success, and Services teams. This involves supporting the creation of documentation and providing semi-formal training specific to technical discovery, deep integration enablement, and complex ongoing support for the Activate product family.
Collaborate with clients to understand their property management workflows and identify opportunities to implement our software effectively.
Act as a bridge between customers and internal teams, providing technical feedback to influence product development.
Partner with the sales team to develop and execute strategies for prospect engagement and client retention.
Partner with Clients, Product and Engineering teams to help shape API roadmap through scoping capabilities for native and third-party applications.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

Deep technical proficiency and ability to understand and communicate complex software solutions, with a strong emphasis on API integrations and technical solution delivery.
Demonstrated expertise in the VTS Activate product suite, with a specific focus on Activate Multifamily and CBRE Host/Host Building products.
3+ years of relevant experience, with commercial real estate property management a plus.
Proficiency with property management software platforms such as Angus and Building Engines.
Proven experience creating and delivering complex software demonstrations and sales presentations.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with clients.
Proven experience working with property managers, tenants, and real estate stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Deep experience with VTS Activate, CBRE Host, or comparable tenant experience/access control software platforms.
Demonstrated knowledge of access control and building management systems (e.g., Kastle, CCure, AMAG, Building Engines, MRI, etc and their integration points.
Experience with additional property management or tenant experience software platforms.
Knowledge of commercial real estate operational workflows, including tenant relations, maintenance, and reporting.

What VTS Values & How We Show It

Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!
Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!
Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!
Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.
Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.
Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

About Vts

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The base salary for this role will range between $135,000 and $165,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography. There is a bonus structure for the position that will bring the OTE (on target earnings) between $145,000 and $190,000, depending on the base salary agreed upon and achievement to goals.

EEO Guidelines

VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know at ta@vts.com
